A finite union yields the tail; strict positivity follows from rho_H(p)<=min(p,|H|) and s>=2. Exact finite tests reproduce truncated factors and sample counts; no infinite conclusion is drawn from the tests.

value.rationale: Holdridge explicitly identifies rational first-coordinate polynomials as an open direction. The theorem completely settles the natural split-monic class of such polynomials at every fixed multiplicity with exact root-count Euler factors, including non-zeta examples such as n(n+1) against every irrational linear floor; it includes arbitrarily well approximable irrationals and arbitrary additional equidistributed coordinates. The split assumption is essential and is not an arbitrary finite slice.
